title: Reviewers for Journal of Insect Science (November 2024–October 2025)
content: The Editor-in-Chief and the Subject Editors of Journal of Insect Science thank the following scientists for their voluntary commitment of valuable professional time and expertise to peer reviewing manuscripts submitted for publication in our journal. The quality and scientific stature of the journal depends on the conscientious efforts of these individuals.
